text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... Falco is just a teeny bit 
tired.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"As an Umadol who gives hope to everyone, 
I shouldn't show such a listless side of 
myself, but—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“Still, taken like that... Doesn't it just 
make your heart skip a beat with how cute 
it is?”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm stuck in this dilemma... 
What am I supposed to dooo...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems fatigue has built up. Perhaps 
I should reconsider the race schedule.
